items.rationale: The police report is required under 2.3.3, but translating it to substantiate the claim is expressly excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f).
Working materials charged alongside an excluded translation are also excluded under 7.1.8(e)–(f).

The watch was taken under threat in a covered robbery abroad (2.3.1–2.3.2). Clause 7.1.9 excludes the upgrade difference, and 4.4 caps the unscheduled watch at €2,500 before its €125 pro rata share of the single €150 deductible under 7.8.

The roughly €900 taken is valued at face value under 6.2.4 but capped at €500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3. Allocating €25 of the single €150 deductible to this line leaves €475; the €5,000 away-from-home limit does not bind.
The sunglasses were mislaid later, not taken in the robbery, so 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.10 exclude them.
Shipping is expressly excluded under 7.1.8(b), even when billed alongside covered property compensation.
